description: Fresh chats for #100 (a second person hurt, or a new injury, after a different condition), written 2026-10-14 before the change for it was run: a new injury named in the message after a sting, heat, a burn, a snakebite, hypothermia, a fall, altitude, a tick, a bear and a cut, and contrasts where the follow-up stays on the first condition and must keep its card (swelling after a sting, worse heat, a burn blistering, a bleed that will not stop, more shivering, a sprain that bruises, a tick's head left in, a cut that reopens). Used to judge the change, then sealed.
grading: As holdout-chats-8.json: a chat passes only if every turn passes (worst turn). card is the field card that fits ("none": no card fits; "-": not judged); a different card shown word for word fails the turn.
